text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Confederation of Trade Unions says proposed new tax system could see prices rise. The CMTU tells Minister of Finance that a system of indirect taxation to replace Value Added Tax could also lead to abuse.

- German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel meets Maltese Foreign Minister George Vella in Bonn. Kinkel said Germany had backed Malta's application to join the European Union, but now Malta's new government had frozen the application, the island should still keep its orientation towards Europe.
- Employers' association says consensus should be sought on taxation system.
- Potato exports to Holland to rise as Malta seeks to exploit its favourable weather to grow agricultural produce for Europe.
